text:
Isha: quick note — onboarding sampleapp spun into a retry loop when my token refresh returned an opaque 500. No hint to stop retrying, users saw infinite spinner.
Tom: Oof. Which SDK/version?
Isha: JS SDK 0.10.4. Network body was just {"message":"internal server error","code":500}.
Ravi: For DX we should standardize a small error envelope: error_type (enum), user_message, retryable (bool), retry_after_ms, and meta (debug only).
Priya: Agree. Also add auth.refreshable boolean when error_type=auth so clients know whether to show interactive login vs try silent refresh.
Tom: Mapping proposal: 401->auth (retryable=false), 403->permission, 422->validation (include invalid_fields), 429->rate_limit (use retry_after_ms), 5xx->transient (retryable=true, capped attempts).
Isha: UX copy: when auth.refreshable=false show "Session expired — sign in to continue" not raw codes. Add telemetry tag dx:error:onboarding.
Ravi: SDK change: typed exceptions (AuthError, RateLimitError, ValidationError, TransientError) + helpers isRetryable(), retryAfter(), isAuthRefreshable(). Export opt-in flag structuredErrors=false to roll out gradually.
Priya: Tests: e2e that simulates 401+refresh-fail ensures UI shows login modal and stops automatic retries. Add a case for 422 to highlight form fields.
sdk-bot: ci/status structured-errors branch tests passed (7/7) :tada:
Tom: Action items: Tom/Ravi add SDK types + helpers (ETA 5d), Isha updates sampleapp + tests (ETA 2d), Priya drafts docs + mapping table (ETA 4d).
Isha: I'll also include a small note in the sampleapp README about how to handle refresh flows on mobile vs web.
Ravi: I'll include meta.raw_id for debugging but make sure it's not surfaced to users.
Priya: Good. We'll check metrics after staging deploy. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
